name: bdd-delivery
description: BDD/SAFe delivery workflow for Claude Code. Shapes work into tickets whose acceptance criteria are Gherkin scenarios, then scaffolds tests from those scenarios as the first half of a stacked PR pair. Tracker-agnostic: Jira and GitHub Issues adapters ship separately from the rules, and site specifics (tracker coordinates, labels, test framework) come from a config file in the consuming repo.
